governing_plan: .claude/learned_search_v02.md, 'MORPHEUS Downstream' Section 2 (external spatial replication protocol) with the definitions of .claude/morpheus_training_and_evaluation_spec.md Sections 0.3-0.11
status: FROZEN before any finding of the learned-search registry is applied to an external cohort: canonical_hash (dbench.downstream.locks.canonical_hash == dbench.prospective_campaign.canonical_hash) recorded in dbench/protocols/ccrcc_external_replication_v03.sha256; a change is a new protocol id
runner: dbench/downstream/replication_v03.py (Agent R); Agent E's v02 runner dbench/scripts/external_replication.py is unchanged and its v01/v02 results stay on record
applies_to: every finding in the internally replicated set of a blind cohort (downstream Section 0 step 3); the family is that set, frozen and hashed before this protocol is applied

external: li2022_ccrcc (Mendeley 10.17632/g67bkbnhhg.1, 16 sections, 8 patients, fresh-frozen whole transcriptome)
zenodo14620362 (3 FFPE probe-based sections, TLS annotations not used)
ccRCC.partition_check: each external cohort is absent from meta-training, development and dictionary construction, confirmed by the partition manifest before the rule is locked
ccRCC.historical_exclusion: if historical task H3b (li2022_ccrcc) is active, li2022_ccrcc leaves the external set before any rule is locked (historical_rediscovery_v02.json)

PFA_ependymoma.external_spatial: unavailable: no independent public PFA Visium cohort with adequate patient count is known; PFA findings are reported with external spatial replication marked unavailable (the 34-patient bulk replication of G03 and the held-aside Fu 2023 spatial patients are reported as such) and are not eligible for Section 4 prioritisation unless a public PFA spatial cohort appears before the lock

rule_file: written per finding before any external value is read (dbench.downstream.replication_v03.rule_file): finding hash, exact candidates with spatial versions, the frozen relation parameters (f_S under B_nuis; f_S under B_known and the frozen B_decomp partition for reporting), the dominant term and its discovery sign, the baselines, the external cohort ids, this platform transformation, this success criterion and the multiplicity family; its canonical hash goes into the external_replication lock (dbench.downstream.locks) before the cohorts are opened

platform_transformation.no_refit: the relation is applied with its frozen parameters; nothing about S or f_S is re-estimated on external data
platform_transformation.normalisation: log1p CPM at 1e4 over each section's panel; gene-set scores = mean over the set's genes that entered the discovery computation
platform_transformation.standardisation: each candidate and the target are within-patient centred (per-patient intercepts) and divided by their pooled within-patient SD computed on the external cohort itself
platform_transformation.nuisance_model: N = ridge on within-patient standardised log1p depth fitted on the external cohort by patient cross-fitting (K = min(5, patients), numpy default_rng(20261016) shuffle of sorted patient keys); predictions for a patient never use that patient
platform_transformation.known_baseline_reported: B_known on the external cohort = N + the 50 Hallmark and 41 Gavish own-spot programme scores (minus the target's set and the candidates' own sets) + the ccRCC B_known catalogue gene-set scores (dbench/downstream/data/bknown_ccrcc_v01.json); CellViT composition is included only where computed for the external cohort and its absence is recorded
platform_transformation.residual_programmes: projected by the frozen loading vector onto the external cohort's covariate-adjusted, per-gene standardised expression; testable when the present genes carry >= 0.95 of the loading's squared norm
platform_transformation.missing_genes: a gene-defined candidate or target with any discovery gene absent from the external panel makes the finding not testable on that cohort; nothing is substituted, imputed or replaced
platform_transformation.neighbours: neighbour versions use the same neighbour counts (6 and 18 nearest spots within section) as discovery, not the same physical radius; contrast = own - 6-neighbour mean
platform_transformation.chemistry: no rank transform: FFPE probe-based and fresh-frozen cohorts receive the same arithmetic; the per-cohort gains are reported so a chemistry effect is visible

gain: G(S, y, B_nuis, L_ext) = R2(base_N + f_S) - R2(base_N) on the within-patient standardised target, computed from per-patient sufficient statistics pooled over every patient of every testable external cohort

success_criterion.ci_excludes_zero: patient-bootstrap 95% percentile interval of the pooled G(S, y, B_nuis, L_ext) has lower bound > 0 (2000 draws, patients resampled within cohort strata, seed 20261021)
success_criterion.direction_agreement_ge_0.60: the dominant term = the candidate with the largest standardised contribution on discovery (drop in R2 when replaced by its support mean); its discovery sign = sign of the mean partial derivative of f_S on discovery rows; per external patient (>= 10 rows) the sign of its coefficient in an OLS of the nuisance-residual target on all candidates of S; agreement in >= 60% of pooled external patients
success_criterion.bh_q_le_0.05: Benjamini-Hochberg within the multiplicity family on the one-sided bootstrap p = (1 + #{draws <= 0}) / 2001

reported_not_gating.B_known: pooled gain and interval with the frozen f_S fitted after B_known on discovery
reported_not_gating.B_decomp: for |S| >= 2: R2(base_N + f_S) - R2(base_N + f_decomp) with the frozen best proper partition
reported_not_gating.per_cohort: gain, patients, rows, direction agreement per cohort
reported_not_gating.moran_matched_null: optional; when computed, gene-defined constituents replaced by Moran-matched random programmes (Agent E's matched_programmes) with the frozen relation applied unchanged; never gates under v03

multiplicity: family = all internally replicated findings of the cohort tested externally
outputs: runs/development/downstream_v01/<run>/<finding_id>/ (locks/, records/, state_card.json); a replication table with one row per finding and cohort; failures are listed with their numbers and are never re-tested with modified variables

supersedes.what_changes: v02 refit the relation on external proposal patients, gated on a Moran-matched null and passed a relation in any one patient-level cohort; v03 applies the frozen relation without refitting, pools the external cohorts, gates on the pooled B_nuis interval + dominant-term sign agreement in >= 60% of external patients + BH within the family, and reports B_known, B_decomp and the matched null without gating (downstream Section 2.2)
